name: reports-concurrent-runs-ci-timeout
goal: The concurrent Reports E2E completes under the 15 minute CI test timeout while still proving two runs keep isolated histories and media through the other run's cleanup.

evidence: PR #39 GitHub Harness verify run 39777141955 on 2ff6d35 annotated test/reports-concurrent-runs.e2e.test.ts:65: Test timed out in 900000ms. Expected behavior is the same two-run history and media isolation proof completing under the CI test timeout; the same test passed locally on dc05acd in 575811ms.

The existing standardized scenario already asserts distinct history homes and commits, media in both histories, first-run cleanup leaving the other history unchanged, 404 for a foreign commit, and final cleanup. The gap is runtime overhead: lasting=60 repeats the whole four-spec run although RunGate already holds teardown and fixture state during the short run. Keep the assertions and use the gate to preserve overlap with fewer repeated browser runs.
